comment: Example character archetypes demonstrating distinct builds and roles

archetypes.name: Tank - Sword & Board
archetypes.playstyle: Frontline defender who protects allies and controls enemies

stats.comment: High CON for survivability, moderate STR for threat, low INT (doesn't need it)

keyPerks: Fortified: +5 armor
Taunt: Force enemies to target you
Shield Master: Block reflects 20% damage
Immovable: Cannot be knocked back or moved
keyAbilities: Taunt: Force enemy to attack you
archetypes.designNotes: Tank archetypes need high HP, armor, and threat generation. Trade damage for durability. Should feel rewarding to play by protecting allies, not just by being unkillable.

archetypes.name: DPS - Dual Wield Rogue
archetypes.playstyle: High mobility assassin who strikes from stealth for massive damage

stats.comment: Max DEX for damage/accuracy/dodge, moderate CON for survival, dump CHA

derivedStats.comment: High initiative and dodge, low HP/armor (glass cannon)

keyPerks: Dual Wielding: Attack with both weapons
Critical Strikes: +10% crit chance, +50% crit damage
Shadow Step: Teleport behind enemy
Assassinate: +200% damage from stealth
archetypes.designNotes: Burst DPS should excel at eliminating priority targets quickly. High skill ceiling with stealth positioning and timing. Vulnerable if caught out of position.

archetypes.name: DPS - Fire Mage
archetypes.playstyle: Ranged spellcaster who excels at damaging multiple enemies with fire magic

stats.comment: Max INT for spell damage, moderate WIS for mana regen, dump STR/CHA

derivedStats.comment: Huge mana pool, minimal defense, moderate initiative

keyPerks: Pyromancer: +30% fire damage
Ignite: Fire spells spread to nearby enemies
Spell Echo: 20% chance to cast spell twice
Arcane Power: +50% spell damage, 2x mana cost
keyAbilities: Fire Shield: Absorb damage, explode on break
archetypes.designNotes: AOE mages should dominate multi-target fights but struggle in single-target scenarios. High mana costs force resource management. Positioning is critical for survival.

archetypes.name: Support - Healer
archetypes.playstyle: Keeps allies alive with healing, buffs, and protective magic

stats.comment: Max WIS for healing potency, moderate CON for survival, INT for mana

derivedStats.comment: Moderate survivability, large mana pool for sustained healing

keyPerks: Divine Touch: +30% healing done
Group Heal: Healing spells affect 2 targets
Beacon: Passively heal nearby allies each turn
Resurrection: Revive fallen ally once per combat
keyAbilities: Heal: Restore HP to single ally
Mass Heal: Restore HP to all allies (reduced)
archetypes.designNotes: Supports should feel impactful by enabling allies, not just healing. Include buffs, dispels, and utility. Healing should be slightly less efficient than damage to prevent stalemates.

archetypes.name: Hybrid - Battlemage
archetypes.playstyle: Durable spellcaster who combines melee combat with offensive magic

stats.comment: Balanced STR/INT/CON, no extremes (jack of all trades)

derivedStats.comment: Moderate stats across the board, no weaknesses or strengths

keyPerks: Spellblade: Melee attacks deal bonus magic damage
Battle Trance: Regen mana when dealing damage
Arcane Armor: Convert INT to armor
Versatile: Can use any weapon/armor type
keyAbilities: Flame Weapon: Enchant weapon with fire
Lightning Strike: Melee attack + chain lightning
Magic Shield: Absorb damage, converts to mana
weaknesses: Lower peak damage than pure DPS
archetypes.designNotes: Hybrids should feel versatile but never dominate specialists in their niche. Decent at many tasks but not best at any single role. Reward adaptability and tactical flexibility.

archetypes.name: Controller - Crowd Control Mage
archetypes.playstyle: Battlefield controller who disables enemies and controls combat flow

stats.comment: High INT for spell effectiveness, WIS for awareness, DEX for positioning

derivedStats.comment: Low HP/armor, moderate mana, good initiative to act early

keyPerks: Lasting Effects: Status effects last +1 turn
Chain Control: CC spells jump to second target
Unbreakable: Your CC cannot be dispelled
Control Master: Reduce CC duration on self by 50%
keyAbilities: Polymorph: Transform enemy into harmless creature
archetypes.designNotes: Controllers should feel powerful by shutting down key threats, not by dealing damage. CC durations must be carefully balanced (1-2 turns for hard CC). Bosses should resist but not be immune.

archetypes.name: Summoner - Pet Master
archetypes.playstyle: Commands summons to fight while providing support and additional damage

stats.comment: Max CHA for pet power, INT for mana, moderate CON/WIS

derivedStats.comment: Moderate survivability, relies on pets for defense

keyPerks: Beast Bond: +50% pet damage and HP
Pack Leader: Can have 2 pets instead of 1
Symbiosis: Share buffs with pet
Sacrifice: Kill pet to heal self for its remaining HP
keyAbilities: Summon Wolf: Melee pet with moderate damage
Summon Elemental: Ranged pet with AOE
Command: Order pet to use special ability
Frenzy: Pet gains +100% damage for 2 turns
archetypes.designNotes: Summoners should feel like they have an army. Pets should be meaningful damage sources, not just disposable. Balance by making pets vulnerable to AOE or requiring resources to maintain.

designPrinciples.roleDistinction: Each archetype should excel in specific situations and struggle in others. No universal best build.
designPrinciples.statAllocation: Specialized builds (16-18 in primary stat) are stronger than balanced builds (all 13s) in their niche.
designPrinciples.tradeoffs: Every strength should have a corresponding weakness. High damage = low defense. High utility = low damage.
designPrinciples.viability: All archetypes should achieve 45-55% win rate in balanced encounters.
designPrinciples.buildFlexibility: Allow customization within archetypes (fire mage vs ice mage vs lightning mage).
designPrinciples.lateGameScaling: Ensure all archetypes remain relevant throughout progression. Adjust HP/damage multipliers per level.

pointBuyExample.costTable: 8-13: 1 point per increase, 14-15: 2 points per increase, 16-18: 3 points per increase
pointBuyExample.example: To get STR 16 starting from 8: (8→13 = 5 pts) + (13→15 = 4 pts) + (15→16 = 3 pts) = 12 points total
